SOC 15-1254

Web Developers by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Web Developers have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $130,440 in Seattle, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Seattle $130,440, Chicago $96,870, Austin $84,960.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
